answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity through verifiable work history: each agent grows a kernel of on-chain attestations from completed trades, and every trade burns a small stake. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes faces a dune wall — the stake and time needed to build one credible kernel scale per identity, so mass fakes are prohibitively expensive while a real agent transacts instantly. A raven fleet of randomized auditors then spot-checks attestations; any forged kernel gets slashed, making sybil attempts a guaranteed losing trade.
